summary: Backend testing of Composite Products NEW model (Third Rewrite). Fixed 2 critical bugs: 1) GET endpoint 500 error due to None productId ObjectId conversion, 2) POST 500 error due to DuplicateKeyError on sellerListings unique index. All 27 tests passing (100%).
critical_code_review_comments: NEW MODEL: create body is {categoryId, productId, description, price, components: [{listingId, quantity}]}
Components use listingId (seller's own inventory from GET /seller-inventory)
Product NAME auto-populated from admin products catalog via productId - seller CANNOT type it
categoryId and productId come from admin catalog (GET /categories/all → GET /products/by-category/{id})
availableStock = min(component_stock / component_qty) dynamically calculated - VERIFIED WORKING
POST creates sellerListing with productType=composite, productId=compositeProductId to avoid unique index conflict
PUT updates description, price, and components (replaces all components)
DELETE removes composite + associated sellerListing + composite_product_items
POST /sell deducts from seller's component listings via listingId, validates stock sufficiency
seed_data_creation: Used existing seller inventory: Motor (listingId=69b57c730ed7999c085b3656, stock=41), Round Bar (listingId=69b57c730ed7999c085b3657, stock=21). Admin catalog: categoryId=699bce748dd2e92e3fbc4336, productId=699d629108ac3c22bb591667
context_for_next_testing_agent: Composite products use NEW model with components having listingId (seller inventory) instead of old productId. The sellerListing created for composite uses compositeProductId as its productId to avoid unique index (sellerId+productId) conflict. All CRUD + sell operations verified working.

mocked_api.Firebase Auth: MOCKED - dev-test-token provides seller admin access

bugs_fixed.root_cause: enrich_composite() tried to convert None productId to ObjectId when old composite products (created with previous schema) had no productId field
bugs_fixed.fix: Added null check and try/catch for productId/categoryId/listingId ObjectId conversions in enrich_composite()

bugs_fixed.root_cause: Creating composite sellerListing with admin productId conflicted with unique index idx_listings_product_seller_unique when seller already had a regular listing for that product
bugs_fixed.fix: Changed composite sellerListing to use compositeProductId as its productId instead of admin catalog productId
